models.label: GPT-5.5
models.description: OpenAI's newest frontier model. Best for complex coding, computer use, knowledge work, and multi-step agentic workflows. Delivers better results with fewer tokens than GPT-5.4.

models.label: GPT-5.4
models.description: Frontier model for professional work with state-of-the-art coding, computer use, and tool search. Incorporates GPT-5.3-Codex's industry-leading coding capabilities. 1M token context.

models.label: GPT-5.4 Mini
models.description: Fast, cost-efficient model for lighter coding tasks and subagents. More than 2× faster than GPT-5.4 while improving on coding, reasoning, and image understanding.

models.label: GPT-5.3 Codex
models.description: Most capable agentic coding model, combining Codex and GPT-5 training stacks. State-of-the-art on SWE-Bench Pro. Best-in-class code generation, reasoning, and general-purpose intelligence.

models.label: GPT-5.3 Codex Spark
models.description: Real-time coding model at 1000+ tokens/second. Highly capable small model optimized for near-instant response on ultra-low latency hardware. Text-only, 128k context. Research preview.

models.label: GPT-5.2
models.description: Previous generation baseline. Solid general-purpose coding capabilities. Recommended for API-key workflows where newer models are unavailable.

models.label: Gemini 3 Flash (Preview)
models.description: Gemini 3 Pro-level reasoning at Flash speed and cost. Configurable thinking levels (minimal, low, medium, high). Supports multimodal input with adjustable media resolution. 1M token context.

models.label: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite (Preview)
models.description: Fastest and most cost-efficient Gemini 3 series model. 2.5× faster time-to-first-token and 45% higher output speed vs Gemini 2.5 Flash. Designed for ultra-low latency, high-volume tasks.

models.label: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.description: Google's first fully hybrid reasoning model. Toggle thinking on or off with a configurable thinking budget. Fast multimodal with text, image, video, and audio input. 1M token context. Generally available.

models.label: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite
models.description: Lightweight, high-throughput variant of Gemini 2.5 Flash optimized for cost-efficient, high-volume workloads with minimal latency.

models.label: Claude Opus 4.7
models.description: Anthropic's most capable model. Best for advanced software engineering, complex reasoning, and demanding multi-step agentic tasks. 13% improvement on coding benchmarks over Opus 4.6. 1M token context.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.description: Balanced intelligence and speed. Supports extended thinking for deeper reasoning. 1M token context (beta). Recommended for most workflows.

models.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.description: Fastest and most cost-efficient Claude model. Matches Sonnet 4 performance on coding, computer use, and agent tasks. 200k token context.

models.label: Qwen Max
models.description: Qwen's most capable flagship model. Best for complex reasoning, professional tasks, and high-accuracy requirements.

models.label: Qwen Plus
models.description: Balanced inference quality, cost, and speed between Qwen Max and Qwen Flash. Supports thinking and non-thinking modes. Ideal for medium-complexity tasks.

models.label: Qwen Turbo
models.description: Legacy model, no longer updated by Alibaba. Consider upgrading to qwen-plus for better performance and continued support.

models.label: Qwen Long
models.description: Specialized for ultra-long document processing with a 10M token context window. Ideal for large-scale document analysis, information extraction, summarization, and classification.
